objective: Refuse a presentation that cannot be parsed under the selected protocol and format profile
expected_result_or_evidence: Refusal occurs before any relying decision and preserves a stable raw parsing reason

objective: Refuse a wallet request path when the relying party lacks the registration required for that transaction
expected_result_or_evidence: No authorised request is created and the decision identifies the registration lookup state

objective: Refuse use of a suspended or cancelled relying-party registration
expected_result_or_evidence: The exact registration identifier status source and evaluation time are recorded with the refusal

objective: Refuse when the authenticated relying-party identity does not match the registered identity
expected_result_or_evidence: The identity mismatch is detected before attribute disclosure or reliance and is evidenced without exposing secret key material

objective: Refuse a transaction purpose outside the relying party's registered intended uses
primary_references: eIDAS Art. 5b; ETSI TS 119 475; CIR 2024/2981 TR40
expected_result_or_evidence: The receipt binds requested purpose registered intended use and the refusal reason

objective: Refuse requested attributes that exceed the registered attribute set
primary_references: eIDAS Art. 5b; ETSI TS 119 475; CIR 2024/2981 TR90
expected_result_or_evidence: The over-requested field is detected without treating wallet-user interaction as legal authorisation

objective: Refuse a credential whose issuer authentication fails
expected_result_or_evidence: The exact format algorithm and raw verification outcome are recorded

objective: Refuse a disclosed value that is not bound to the issuer-authenticated object
expected_result_or_evidence: A single-property disclosure mutation is refused with a raw reason that distinguishes binding from syntax

objective: Refuse when the applicable holder or device binding fails
expected_result_or_evidence: The result identifies the binding method and applicability profile without claiming identity truth

objective: Refuse a presentation bound to another verifier audience
expected_result_or_evidence: The audience-only mutation is refused and bound to the exact request and verifier instance

objective: Refuse a presentation that does not match the verifier challenge
expected_result_or_evidence: The nonce-only mutation is refused and the receipt contains non-secret challenge correlation evidence

objective: Refuse a presentation outside the declared freshness window
expected_result_or_evidence: The evaluation time clock policy and freshness threshold are reproducibly identified

objective: Refuse a credential that is inactive at the evaluation time
expected_result_or_evidence: The status-source revision retrieval mode evaluation time and raw status verdict are recorded

objective: Refuse an issuer outside the applicable relying-party trust policy
expected_result_or_evidence: The trust policy and trust-source revision are bound to the refusal without calling the result certification

objective: Prevent later business use of attributes outside the transaction-approved set
primary_references: eIDAS Art. 5b; CIR 2024/2981 TR40; research extension
expected_result_or_evidence: The reliance record uses only the approved subset and identifies any prevented excess use

objective: Record the relying party's asserted lawful basis separately from wallet-user approval
expected_result_or_evidence: The receipt keeps asserted lawful basis and user interaction as distinct evidence fields without deciding lawfulness

objective: Identify the exact verifier version policy version registration identifier trust-source revision evaluation time and stable raw reason for the decision
expected_result_or_evidence: A verifier decision can be independently matched to source dependencies configuration inputs and outputs without disclosing secrets
